// Lists every file under <dir> with its SHA-256 and size (sorted), and prints a tree hash over the listing.
// Usage: node dist-hash.mjs <dir> <listing-out>
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { readdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';

const root = process.argv[2];
const out = process.argv[3];
if (!root || !out) throw new Error('usage: node dist-hash.mjs <dir> <listing-out>');
const files = [];
function walk(dir, rel) {
  for (const entry of readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    const relPath = rel === '' ? entry.name : `${rel}/${entry.name}`;
    if (entry.isDirectory()) walk(join(dir, entry.name), relPath);
    else files.push(relPath);
  }
}
walk(root, '');
files.sort((a, b) => (a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0));
let total = 0;
let maps = 0;
let mapRefs = 0;
const lines = files
  .map((p) => {
    const data = readFileSync(join(root, p));
    total += data.length;
    if (p.endsWith('.map')) maps += 1;
    if (data.includes('sourceMappingURL')) mapRefs += 1;
    return `${createHash('sha256').update(data).digest('hex')} ${data.length} ${p}\n`;
  })
  .join('');
writeFileSync(out, lines);
console.log(`files=${files.length} bytes=${total} maps=${maps} sourceMappingURL=${mapRefs} tree=${createHash('sha256').update(lines).digest('hex')}`);
